The '''Irishi sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Selnesh/Legends|Selnesh]] and [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]].
